title: Cream Shearling & Striped Top
prompt: An original young woman with long dark hair wears a cream shearling bonnet and a matching shearling-trimmed jacket. Under it, a brown and cream striped top with a lace hem and a gold cross pendant. She holds one arm up beside an open car door, and her expression is confident and a little playful. Snowy hills and a vivid blue sky stretch behind her. Bright, crisp sunlight, a palette of cream, camel, and cobalt blue. Playful and bold, in the style of a street-style winter lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The shearling textures and striped top are the signature details.
- Keep the raised arm for a dynamic pose.
